title: Smiling Child with Basset Hound by Christmas Tree, 1962 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A square snapshot with deckle edges capturing a joyful mid-century holiday morning. A young child with short dark hair, wearing a white smock top adorned with heart appliqués, beams happily beside an artificial white-flocked Christmas tree decorated with spherical ornaments. Seated prominently on the floor in front of the child is a patient basset hound, with a large-eyed vintage doll propped up nearby. Behind them sit wrapped gift boxes alongside a painted brick fireplace with fireplace tools. The margin is stamped 'JAN • 62', reflecting the classic post-Christmas development period of early 1962 in suburban America.
